dedupe_keys.name: industryforge a reproducible pipeline for plant level european industrial energy and co2

description: The IndustryForge research team publishes an open pipeline for allocating European national industrial energy, production and carbon dioxide figures to individual installations. Zenodo provides version 0.3.0 as a public source archive under MIT and links a separate 2023 plant-level data build already in the catalogue. The description says national energy-balance totals are conserved by construction and each output carries typed provenance and two quality axes. That makes the tool relevant for preparing plant-demand inputs for energy supply or industrial decarbonisation simulations. No related catalogue platform record explicitly covers the pipeline itself; the companion dataset is a distinct output. A limitation is that allocation from national statistics does not make every plant-level value an observed meter measurement. Version 0.3.0 is the first tagged release, and future input updates or changes in facility coverage may alter outputs. The public page does not list dependency versions or all source licences. The code archive was not downloaded, installed or run; the separately reported automated checks were not independently reproduced.
